messages:
Kate H: Uploaded the OKR draft to the drive: https://redwood.link/okr-draft-17125. Need a quick triage on scope — we have too many candidate initiatives. Can we narrow to top 3 by EOW?
Jason M: Quick note from exec: prioritize reliability & enterprise readiness. Customers keep asking for Private deployment and stronger SLAs.
Lina C: From eng side — we should avoid surface API changes this quarter. If we take Dedicated scaling as a priority we need ~8w of focused work.
Marcus V: Agree with Lina. Suggest we treat Dedicated as a multi-phase project. If we must pick three, make one of them an M1 pilot, not full GA.
Anika P: I consolidated customer asks into a sheet and tagged by urgency + ARR impact. Sharing: https://redwood.link/customer-asks-q4. Also proposing concrete launch criteria: uptime SLA >= 99.9%, p95 latency < 100ms @ 2048 tokens on target hw.
Rob K: Add a quality gating metric: eval regression rate > 2% across the held prompt set should block rollout. Also log-level traces for regressions.
Kate H: OK — proposed trimmed slate (for discussion):
1) Private VPC GA (security/compliance first)
2) Console analytics revamp (visibility for customers + internal ops)
3) Dedicated reserved capacity (pilot -> GA)
Are we aligned on ordering and acceptance criteria?
Jason M: Prefer 1) Private VPC GA and 2) Console revamp first. Dedicated can be piloted after those. That addresses the customer requests about data isolation and observability.
Lina C: If Dedicated is low-pri, we can reallocate the Dedicated eng lane to Private + Console. Rough ETA: Private 10w, Console 6w with current staffing.
Kate H: Which customers would be most impacted if we defer Dedicated?
Anika P: Top flagged: FinCorp (security constrained), AdsCo (throughput), and HealthSys (on-prem interest). FinCorp is specifically leaning on Private VPC more than Dedicated. AdsCo would prefer Dedicated for throughput headroom.
Marcus V: Proposed compromise: ship Private VPC GA + Console in Q4, run a small Dedicated pilot (2 customers) in Q4, and plan full Dedicated GA in Q1. This keeps security customers happy and buys us time for performance tuning.
Kate H: Vote: react with :thumbsup: to accept Marcus' phased proposal, :thumbsdown: to keep the original 3-priority simultaneous slate. Please react by EOD.
Jason M: :thumbsup:
Lina C: :thumbsup:
Rob K: :thumbsup:
Anika P: :thumbsup: (will update the customer tracker to reflect the phased plan)
Kate H: Excellent. I'll update the deck and the OKR draft to reflect phased Dedicated.
deploy-bot: OKR deck exported to PDF and uploaded: https://redwood.link/okr-draft-17125.pdf
Kate H: One more thing — launch blocking checklist to include:
```
- SLAs validated on staging and perf lab
- Eval regression < 2% on benchmark suite
- Automated rollback tested for model and config
- Documentation + release notes ready
```
Kate H: If no objections, I'll move this to final sign-off thread tomorrow. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
